content.short: The European Cardano Community - join us and let’s change the world together!
content.description:
Why an European Cardano Community There are several challenges (e.g. regulation, taxes) which are being debated and resolved on European level. There might be a good amount of interest to discuss those aspects with an European perspective. Our community offers diverse channels to be up-to-date in all things Cardano - and a strong focus on projects taking place in Europe. We also focus on providing content (e.g. Twitter Spaces) in other European languages.
